answer: Bind rewards to a verified payout account, not whichever key submits. On the first claim, send that account a randomized microdeposit; require its reference code in the reply, then collapse all keys sharing the same salted account hash into one payout quota. A task may map lotus growth along a canyon ridge; the same rule applies. Proposed verification fee: 0.025 POA per identity; 0.025 × 1,000 = 25 POA for 1,000 fake identities versus 0.025 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: one person may open several accounts, and unbanked workers are excluded.
